name: publish-announcer
description: When a new product or article goes live, posts a short summary and link to Slack and drafts social posts for it, so the whole team knows what launched and has copy ready to share.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: A product or article is created or changed

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: That it has just gone live, not that it was saved as a draft or edited again

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short summary and its link to your Slack channel

howItWorks.label: Drafts
howItWorks.text: Social posts for the networks you pick, in the same message

plugins.reason: Posts the announcement to your team's channel

data.description: The product name or article headline
The description or article body to summarise
Whether the record is live (a status, a published flag or a published date)
The public URL, or the slug to build it from
The product's price, for the Slack summary only

parameters.label: Storefront URL
parameters.description: Used to build links from slugs
